title: Giant Pandas, Icons of China’s Soft Diplomacy, Arrive in Atlanta
summary_full: A male named Ping Ping and a female named Fu Shuang landed on Sunday, days after China’s leader said he would dispatch “envoys of friendship” to the United States.
